FN-F33YCDD-1
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 354
Committee: Urban and Rural Development Sponsor: Representative Randall Shedd
Analyst: Tiffany Weaver Date: 04/01/2024
House Bill 354 as introduced would provide that grants awarded from sales taxes collected on
the sale of alcoholic beverages within a community development district would be distributed
based on the recommendation of each legislator representing a portion of the county. This bill
would not otherwise affect state or local funding.
